svg.text: Figure 5: Generating the seed query of the running example
Left: AST in generation order (①–⑤). Right: scope table after each step; highlighted rows are added by the step, struck-out rows are no longer visible.
WITH v1 AS v2, v1.score AS v3
site at v2.flag: Boolean slot for SC1
visible {v1, v2, v3}; anchor candidates: v1, v2
(node, labels ≠ ∅, non-null); v3 is a float
RETURN v1 AS v5, v4 AS v6
after ② CALL body: imports exactly (v1)
after ③ WITH projects v2, v3; Neo4j keeps v1
after ④ same table; RETURN outputs v4
output column: v4 bool (only this leaves the CALL)
after ⑤ outer query: only v4 leaves the CALL
RETURN v1 AS v5, v4 AS v6 → output columns v5, v6
variable name, numbered in creation order; final when created
value type: node, relationship, path, int, float, bool, string, list_T
labels every binding carries: from its node pattern, or copied by a direct alias WITH x AS y
true iff declared by OPTIONAL MATCH (or an alias of such a variable)
imported: visible via CALL imports or an enclosing scope; local: declared in this query part
